2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the page_counter_try_charge() function to be aware of stock, allowing it to consume stock transparently while preserving existing semantics. Two new parameters are added: may_batch and nr_charged. The first parameter preserves the behavior of !allow_spinning scenarios in try_charge_memcg, where the goal is to charge as quickly as possible without evicting other stock slots or making a greedy charge to refill the stock. The second parameter reflects the size of the successful hierarchy charge, preserving existing batch-based memory.high accounting for current->memcg_nr_pages_over_high.
